en: Huh? Was I sleeping?{PAGE}Oh, right, I was studying. I guess I{SAUT}ended up falling asleep...
I feel like I just had some dream, but...{SAUT}Hm?
, you in there?
Oh, uh―yeah! What is it?
Oh, you ARE here! Great!
, did you zone out{SAUT}enough to drool on yourself?{PAGE}Hahaha, you're such a Space Detective!
Say what!?
Just kidding!
Are you stupid or something?{PAGE}...Seriously, are you THAT stupid?
Man, Yuka-tan, your riposte is as sharp{SAUT}as ever!
Were you really napping in here? That's{SAUT}kind of surprising.
Hey, what's the holdup?
This guy wouldn't shut up about findin'{SAUT}you... So we came to get you.
Everyone, our drinks are going to get{SAUT}cold if we don't get back downstairs.
Takeba, have you prepared the{SAUT}snacks?
Oh yeah. You know it!{PAGE}I've got cookies, chocolate, and{SAUT}a whole bunch of popcorn.
I never took you for the popcorn type,{SAUT}Yuka-tan.
Shut it. I get a craving sometimes―so{SAUT}what!?
It seems that we are all ready.
Bark!
-chan? What's wrong?
You seem pretty out of it... You got{SAUT}a fever or somethin'?
Oh no, it's just... I feel like I'm finally{SAUT}home...
Hm? Whatever do you mean?
Ahaha... I dunno.{PAGE}But, I do wonder... I feel like I've been{SAUT}wanting to see you guys for a long time.
Did you have a bad dream{SAUT}or something?
Umm, I don't think that's it...{PAGE}Anyways―what's going on, everyone?{SAUT}Did you need something?
Mmhm. We've all been talking about{SAUT}watching a movie together downstairs...
Our Boss has given us the greenlight to{SAUT}do so. You go, girl!
...I've been wondering this for quite{SAUT}some time now, but where in the world{SAUT}do you learn such language?
You'll watch it with us, won't you?{SAUT}It's a sci-fi movie.
Watch a movie? A... sci-fi movie?
Yep! C'mon, let's go!
...Sure!
